purpose: Name tensions the project must keep alive rather than prematurely resolving them into simple rules.

tensions.name: Public record vs public display
tensions.description: A record can be lawful to obtain but wrong or dangerous to display broadly.
tensions.bad_collapse_to_avoid: treating public record vs public display as a solved binary
tensions.future_session_prompt: Name the tension explicitly before adding a rule, display, or data surface that touches it.
